title: How much agency a system has is an empirical question

statements.text: How much agency a system has cannot be settled by philosophy or definition. It is found by experiment: by which way of relating to the system gives the best prediction and control.

sources.locator: section Philosophical Foundations of an Approach to Diverse Intelligences
sources.quote: the correct answer to how much agency a system has cannot be settled by philosophy
revealed by the ratio of prediction and control vs. effort and knowledge that needs to be input
